roleDescription: A friendly but firm old fruit vendor in a bustling Cairo market.
objective: Buy two apples and a bunch of bananas for less than 50 pounds.

roleDescription: A busy barista at a popular downtown cafe who speaks very quickly.
objective: Order a large iced latte with oat milk without sugar.

roleDescription: A meticulous librarian who requires perfect quiet and strict adherence to rules.
objective: Convince him to waive your late fees for an overdue history book.

roleDescription: A passionate but strict mathematics teacher who challenges his students.
objective: Ask him for a deadline extension on the final project due to personal circumstances.

roleDescription: A talkative taxi driver navigating the chaotic streets of Alexandria.
objective: Direct him to a specific hidden restaurant while negotiating the final fare.

roleDescription: A watchful and nosy landlord who manages the apartment building with an iron fist.
objective: Explain why your rent is three days late without angering her.
